question:
Select the most appropriate **antonym** of the word given in the bracket.

It is surprising to see _________ (stale) apples available throughout the year.
solution:
The correct answer is "**fresh**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Stale**' refers to something old, not fresh, or past its best. (बासी)

 
 
• **Example**- The bread I bought yesterday is already stale.
 
 
 
• '**Fresh**' represents something newly made or obtained. (ताजगी)
 
 
• **Example**- The strawberries are fresh and very sweet.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is opposite in meaning to the given word is 'fresh'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• '**Old**' means having been in existence for a long time. (पुराना) 
 
• '**Musty**' means smelling damp and stale. (फफूंदीदार) 
 
• '**Stuffy**' means lacking fresh air or ventilation. (बेहवा)
